page.title: Zvinobatanidza
page.intro: Batanidza maakaundi ako ekushambadza. Vanotungamira kubva kuma ads ako vanoguma mu Vatungamiri vangu vega, nekushandisa uye mutengo wekutungamira.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form inotungamira muVatungamiri Vangu, zuva ngezuva kupedza uye mutengo wekutungamira, uye kutungamirira kunaka kunotumirwa kudzokera LinkedIn ( Conversions API ).
catalog.notAvailable: Hazvina kuiswa pane iyi server parizvino .

banner.connected: LinkedIn yakabatana. Leads dzirikutorwa zvino - peji ino inogadzirisa munguwa pfupi.
banner.notConfigured: LinkedIn haina kuiswa pane iyi server parizvino. Mutungamiri anofanira kuwedzera LinkedIn app yemutengi ID uye chakavanzika.
banner.expired: Kubatana LinkedIn kwapera, saka vanotungamira havasi kuenderana. Batanidza zvakare kuti uenderere mberi.
banner.reconnectSoon: LinkedIn inoda kuti iwe upinde zvakare nge {{date}} . Batanidzazve asati ipapo kuti ugare unotungamira uchiyerera.

connect.title: Batanidza LinkedIn
connect.intro: Nyoresa ngeakaundi LinkedIn inotarisira zvishambadzo zvako. Leadrat inoerenga chete maakaundi ako ekushambadza, Lead Gen Form inotungamira uye zviyero zvekushambadza, uye inotuma kutendeuka iwe unochinja.
connect.need1: A basa pane LinkedIn ad akaundi (Muoni kana yakakwirira).
connect.need2: Mutemo pane peji yekambani yakabatana (Mutungamiriri, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Curator kana Muongorori) - LinkedIn inoda kuti igovere vanotungamira.
connect.need3: Mubvunzo wenhamba yefoni paLead Lead Gen Forms yako - inotungamira isina nhamba yefoni haikoni kuwedzerwa.

connection.title: Kubatana
connection.syncResult: Sync yakaitwa: {{received}} yakaashirwa, {{created}} yakasikwa, {{duplicates}} yakadzokororwa, {{rejected}} yakarambwa.
connection.confirmDisconnect: Kudzima LinkedIn ? Syncing inomira uye mathokheni ekuwana anodzimwa. Inotungamira, nhamba uye chinyorwa chezviitiko zvinochengetedzwa.
connection.noPermission: Unokona kuona peji iri. Kubatanidza uye kuchinja zvirongwa zvinoda "Kutarisira Zvirongwa" mvumo.
connection.fetchHint: Vatungamiri vatsva vanoongororwa maminitsi mashomanana ega ega uye mazuwa 7 ekupedzisira anoongororwa kakurutu zuwa ngezuwa, saka hapana chinoshaikwa. Shandisa izvi kune vanotungamira kubva usati wabatana, kana kuongorora nguva zvakare (kusvika mazuva makumi mapfumbamwe panguwa imwe). Vanotungamira vatove Leadrat vanorekeredzwa.

accounts.title: Ad akaundi .
accounts.intro: Vanotungamira uye nhamba dzinofananidzwa kubva kumaakaundi ekushambadza akachinjwa pano.
accounts.none: Hapana akaundi yekushambadza inowanikwa yeakaundi iyi LinkedIn . Tarisa basa reakaundi mu LinkedIn Campaign Manager , uye wozorodza.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Udza LinkedIn kuti ndeipi yevatungamiri vayo yakava tarisiro chaiyo. Kana LinkedIn lead yasvika pachigaro chaunosarudza pazasi, Leadrat inozvibhuya ku LinkedIn , saka mishumo yako yemushandirapamwe inokombidza kunaka kwekutungamira uye LinkedIn inokona kuwana anhu akawanda anoda vatungamiri vako vakanakisa. LinkedIn chete inotungamira ID uye imwe-nzira hash ye email inotumirwa.
capi.created: Kutendeuka kwakagadzirwa LinkedIn uye kwakaiswa pamepu.

activity.title: Chinyorwa chezviitiko
activity.intro: Zveshe pakati pe Leadrat ne LinkedIn : kubatana, kubatana kweshe, kutungamira kweshe nezvakaitika kwairi, kutendeuka nekukanganisa.
